req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-020 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type is exactly text/html and body contains the exact FastAPI-injected title string, catching constant/string mutations. Each test uses TestClient in-process, asserts exact values, and is self-contained.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with title='Task Manager API'
Swagger UI is enabled at /docs (FastAPI default)
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the in-process FastAPI app
expected: Response body contains the string 'swagger' (case-insensitive marker)
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "text/html" in content_type
    body_lower = r.text.lower()
    assert "swagger" in body_lower

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_post_returns_405
preconditions: GET /docs is the only allowed method for the Swagger UI endpoint
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the in-process FastAPI app
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 405 (Method Not Allowed)
trace: R-TASK-020: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
Using wrong HTTP verb is a client error that must not return 2xx
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_post_returns_405():
    r = client.post("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_body_contains_api_title
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with title='Task Manager API'
Swagger UI HTML embeds the app title
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the in-process FastAPI app
Inspect response body for the exact app title string
expected: Response body contains the exact string 'Task Manager API'
Response body contains 'swagger-ui' or 'SwaggerUI' as a Swagger UI marker
trace: R-TASK-020: expected payload must be interactive Swagger UI
BVA: exact title string boundary — mutation of title constant would be caught
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_body_contains_api_title():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "Task Manager API" in r.text
    body_lower = r.text.lower()
    assert "swagger-ui" in body_lower or "swaggerui" in body_lower

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_content_type_is_exactly_html
preconditions: GET /docs serves HTML, not JSON or plain text
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the in-process FastAPI app
expected: Content-Type header does not start with 'application/json'
trace: R-TASK-020: payload must be interactive Swagger UI (HTML), not raw JSON
BVA: content-type boundary distinguishes HTML from JSON openapi spec
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_content_type_is_exactly_html():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert content_type.startswith("text/html")
    assert not content_type.startswith("application/json")

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_not_found_on_wrong_path
preconditions: Swagger UI is only at /docs, not at /doc or /swagger
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the in-process FastAPI app
trace: R-TASK-020: Swagger UI is specifically at /docs; adjacent paths must not match
NEG: wrong path is a client error (4xx)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_not_found_on_wrong_path():
    r1 = client.get("/doc")
    assert r1.status_code == 404
    assert r1.status_code != 200
    r2 = client.get("/swagger")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 200
